newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary O/N rates end steady at 20.5 pct.
newsitem.headline: Hungary O/N rates end steady at 20.5 pct.

text.p: Hungary's overnight interest ended unchanged at 20.5 percent on Thursday despite the passing of a tax payment deadline, dealers said.
Rates rose towards 21.00 percent in early trade but fell back to Wednesday's closing level of 20.5 percent by the end of trade.
"The slight rise was probably due to a small shortage of funds for tax payments but that had passed by the close," said Gabor Butor of Unicbank.
Dealers said they expected little change in a generally liquid market.
